text:
Nina: quick thread
Vectorix (hw) asked for a private-offer play that accelerates co-sell momentum: small commit + front-loaded hw credits for SI pipeline. want low ops and clear renewal mechanics. thoughts? :wave:
Carlos: keep it simple. propose two buckets: Accelerator (90-day ramp) and Steady (12m commit). Accelerator = $150k commit -> 20% discount + $30k onboarding hw invoice credit. Steady = $400k -> 25% discount + $80k hw credit.
Ellen: finance perspective: invoice credit preferred. for Accelerator, we need a clawback if they cancel in 60 days. for Steady, clawback window 120 days. activation floor for Accelerator $50k ARR, Steady $120k ARR.
Raj: SI POV: make Accelerator easy to quote. public SKU like `redwood.marketplace:vectorix-accelerator-v1` and include a one-pager with sell motions. also request a short demo customer for the pilot.
Carlos: ops ask: catalog fields needed: offer_label, partner_sku, commit_usd, term_months, discount_pct, credit_type, credit_amount_usd, credit_expiry_days, activation_floor_usd, clawback_days, restricted_listing_bool. will file spec.
Nina: renewal mechanics: for Accelerator, if they convert to Steady within term, apply a conversion bonus credit of 5% of first-year commit as invoice credit. for Steady, offer a 3% renewal uplift if renew >=85% of prior commit.
Ellen: accounting: conversion bonus must be a separate AR line item; map to SKU `vectorix.conversion.bonus.v1`. finance-bot, confirm rev-rec impact?
finance-bot: confirmed: onboarding and conversion credits recorded as invoice credits; wallet option would require deferred revenue treatment. prefer invoice credits for visibility.
Raj: pilot timeline: T-14 partner enablement, T-7 pilot with SI and 1 customer, T = listing + joint announcement. prefer quick pilot to validate billing.
Nina: legal note: include standard fraud clause and prorated clawback language. i'll loop legal.
ops-bot: created kickoff event "Vectorix private-offer kickoff" for T-14; invites sent to partnerships, finance, legal, eng-catalog, eng-billing, SI leads.
Nina: next steps: Carlos files offer spec, Ellen finalizes SKU mapping, Raj lines up pilot customer, i'll draft partner-facing one-pager. will post ADO card after specs. thanks all :rocket:
